_what: Performance budget for the guard in PERF_BUDGET_GUARD.md (task 220). Read by tools/overnight/run-budget-check.sh (task 230; owner Q-AO (b), N = 5). The baseline is a RATCHET: the check fails when a number gets worse than the baseline by more than its tolerance; the targets are reported as distance only (today every arm is 3x over them, so failing on them would fail every run and teach everyone to ignore it).
status: PROVISIONAL -- numbers below are copied from tasks 212 and 219; the first run of run-budget-check.sh replaces 'baseline' with its own run (same script, same poses), and tasks 227-229 re-baseline when they cut cost.
machine: MacBook Air M1, 8 GB, fanless; AC power; warm steady state (one discarded warm-up launch first)

settings._why: Play's own look (owner 2026-11-16 Q-AN: keep the look). 219 showed the presets change memory, not time (Low 108.0 vs High 111.4 ms), so the check runs what the owner plays.
settings.upscaler: fsr3 pinned at 432 rows (play's dyn floor; dyn sits there whenever a frame is > 30 ms)
settings.flags: tools/play-flags.sh ($PLAY_SETTINGS_FLAGS): trees, shells, torch flood, sky fill 2, FSR 3
settings.launch: run-budget-check.sh: $PLAY_SETTINGS_FLAGS -quality high -renderrows 432 -shellwait 60; day adds -startsun 0 (noon) -costfixed forest_eye -costarms <steps' off_arm>; night adds -costpaths torch -costarms tf_on,tl_none

targets._note: Reported as 'distance to target', never a FAIL until the baseline is inside them.

hard_limits._note: These DO fail the check regardless of the baseline.

tolerance._basis: 212's two launches (Logs/costsplit_2026-11-15_143504.txt, _160531.txt): FULL p50 at walk_near 104.3-108.2 ms across 12 F passes (spread ~4 ms, ~4 %); lighting deltas F - X repeat within ~2-3 ms. 224: process peak launch-to-launch spread ~+-50 MB.

paths.walk_near: MODE=walk arc (task 212), noon 12.00 h, sun 78 deg -- DAY: sky fill, sun, shells; flood should cost ~0 here (task 229)
paths.torch: -costpaths torch (task 151): night 0.50 h, 28-32 torches round a still pose. The scene's FULL is the OLD point lights; the check times arms tf_on (play's torch flood) and tl_none (no torch light): night play p50 = tf_on, torch_flood step = tf_on - tl_none (task 230)
paths.forest_eye: -costfixed forest (task 210/219), eye height, noon -- dense trees; SECONDARY (219 had a streaming deficit at this pose: report, do not fail on it)
paths._pose_note: forest_eye_pose is pinned here (copied from Logs/TerrainGen/trees210/poses.txt) so the check's pose cannot drift with that file.

steps.name: torch_flood
steps._8_17: Reserve: torches at night (share is for the NIGHT path; day share 0)

steps.name: ceiling
steps._note: sky probe + sun + shells off together: what is left (CPU, FSR 3, tier-0 march, shading/post)

_steps_rule: A look/content task that adds a pass appends a step here with its off_arm (a -costarms name it registers) and the share it takes (from 'shading/post' 5.0 ms or a named reserve, per AMENDMENT_8_17 section 3).
